facts.business: SVP Global Textiles Limited is a textile manufacturing company.

auditor.name: Motilal & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on CIRP against key step subsidiaries, trade receivables/payables/loans subject to balance confirmations, and borrowings with non-compliance of debt covenants and lender balance confirmations not obtained.

key_risks: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) initiated against key step subsidiaries
Trade receivables, trade payables, and loans receivables subject to balance confirmations from third parties
Borrowings with instances of non-compliance with debt covenants and monies recalled by lenders
Various tax litigations pending before authorities with uncertain outcomes and timing of cash outflows
